claims.text: The proposed model is compared to the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN), which is a state-of-the-art machine reading comprehension model.
The proposed model outperforms the R.M.-Reader + Verifier model by 0.7 in terms of F1 score.
The proposed model is also compared with many existing MRC systems that extract answers by finding sub-strings in passages.
